title: New Mobile Suit Gundam Seed Movie Revival Trailer Reveals Best Look Yet – Watch Now
content:
Mobile Suit Gundam SEED is coming back next year with a new revival movie hitting theaters across the world, and a new trailer and poster is showing off the best look at what to expect from it yet. There have been quite a few revival projects for the Mobile Suit Gundam SEED iterations for the past few years with it most recently hitting screens with Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Freedom , a sequel to the Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny TV series. But that’s far from all.

Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Freedom ZERO is the next major feature film entry in the franchise, and serves as a prequel to the Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Freedom film . It’s a project that has been in the works for about two decades at this point, and now fans have gotten the best look at it yet with a new trailer and poster revealing more of it in action ahead of its launch next year. You can check it out below.

When Does Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Freedom Zero Come Out?

Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Freedom Zero will first be hitting theaters across Japan on January 15th, and then will be making its way to theaters in North America sometime in February next year but has yet to confirm a concrete release date as of this time. Mitsuo Fukuda directs the film for Sunrise and Bandai Namco Filmworks with a script provided by Chiaki Morosawa, Shigeru Morita and director Mitsuo Fukuda. Hisashi Hirai provides the character designs, and Toshihiko Sahashi will be composing the music for the film.

Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Freedom Zero also revealed with this trailer that the opening theme is titled “Absolute Zero,” as performed by Takanori Nishikawa with t.komuro. The ending theme is titled “Yugure o Matsu Nostalgia,” as performed by See-Saw. It’s also set to bring back the original Japanese voice cast behind the classic TV series for this new revival , and the English dub anchors are returning as well with the likes of Matthew Erickson as Shinn Asuka, Matt Hill as Kira Yamato and Sam Vincent as Athrun Zala all confirmed thus far.

What’s Next for Mobile Suit Gundam ?

If you wanted to catch up with the classic Mobile Suit Gundam SEED TV series in the meantime, there’s an easy way to do so as it’s now available for streaming through Gundam’ s official YouTube channel. You can also go back and check out the Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Freedom film now streaming with platforms such as Netflix , Crunchyroll, Hulu, and Hulu on Disney+. But there’s even more in the works as there are some new releases on the way.

Mobile Suit Gundam RG XARX-ZERO is a brand new anime in the franchise now in the works for a release some time in April next year , and it will be kicking off a whole new timeline for the franchise. Set within the same universe as the upcoming Gundam Rogue Orbit videogame, it’s been teased to be a fresh new start for fans to jump into. What are you hoping to see from the new Gundam SEED Freedom revival? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: Dragon Ball Super Trolls Fans Over Black Frieza’s Future
content:
Dragon Ball Super has been left on a major Frieza cliffhanger for the past two years while it’s been on hiatus, and the franchise just won’t let fans forget it by trolling with Black Frieza. Dragon Ball Super had gone on hiatus back in 2024 following the death of franchise creator Akira Toriyama, and it’s meant that the manga’s story has yet to move forward all this time . Part of what makes the manga’s future even more intriguing is the fact that Frieza is currently the strongest being in the universe.

In the current Dragon Ball Super timeline as of where it reached its hiatus, Black Frieza is now the most powerful fighter in Universe 7 with no potential return just yet. It’s been something fans have been waiting to see in action since after the end of the Granolah the Survivor arc , but unfortunately has been left as the major cliffhanger over Dragon Ball Super’ s uncertain future. And now Dragon Ball ‘s social media account is poking fun at it.

Dragon Ball Super Reminds Fans About Black Frieza

It might not be more than a post reminding fans about Black Frieza over the Black Friday shopping weekend, but it just unfortunately seems a bit ill-timed considering that it’s been two years without any update about Dragon Ball Super’ s manga future. It ended with an adaptation of the Dragon Ball Super: Super Hero feature film with some of the final elements overseen by Akira Toriyama himself, and is technically the current end of the Dragon Ball Super timeline . But the conclusion there is far from an actual ending.

The end of the Dragon Ball Super: Super Hero arc would have been a fine enough finale for the series had we only seen the anime’s version, but the manga’s version of the events happen with included context from the Galactic Patrol Prisoner and Granolah the Survivor arcs only seen in the manga. And these arcs introduce a returning godlike version of Frieza, and that unfortunately still needs to be addressed in order for Dragon Ball Super ‘s story to actually come to its end. It’s one major villain still floating around out there.

Will Dragon Ball Super’ s Manga Ever Return?

As of the time of this writing, we’re heading into the third year of Dragon Ball Super ‘s hiatus. Though artist Toyotaro has shared his interest in returning to the series to keep the story moving forward, Shueisha themselves seems to be holding back on any kind of update at least through to the next year. This is something they are going to have to address soon enough, however, as Dragon Ball Super’s anime is going to hit a break wall sooner than fans might think.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus is a new remake anime series picking up from the very beginning, and it’sairing new episodes this Fall. The anime will then continue with Dragon Ball Super: The Galactic Patrol , which adapts one of the missing arcs from the manga. With only one last arc available after that and only two arcs left to remake from the classic series, the franchise is going to need brand new materials soon. But are you hoping to see Black Frieza in action someday? Let us know your thoughts in the comments.

title: Fuyu Yukimiya Launches Girl Meets Cakeboy Manga
content:
The January issue of Kodansha 's Dessert magazine announced on Monday Fuyu Yukimiya will launch a new manga titled Girl Meets Cakeboy (pictured bottom right in image below) in the February issue on December 24. Riku Bancha is credited with the original work.

The series follows a high school girl who has a surprising encounter at the Dessert store where she works part-time.

Kodansha USA Publishing releases Yukimiya's Sakura's Dedication manga in English. The series launched on Kodansha 's Palcy platform in April 2021. Kodansha shipped the fifth and final volume in November 2023. Kodansha USA Publishing released the fifth volume in English in April 2024.

title: South Park Season 29 Finale Officially Brings Back Kenny After Horrifying Twist
content:
South Park Season 29 officially brought Kenny back to life in its final episode, but it was after they made fans squirm with some horrifying scares at first. South Park made some big swings with its return this year as it kicked off by revealing that the town and the show would be renamed to “South America .” That wasn’t the only big event, however, as the final few moments of the premiere also killed off Kenny McCormick for the first real time in years.

With South Park killing off Kenny in the premiere episode, and keeping him dead through the rest of the episodes , the final episode of Season 29 then took things full circle. Using Kenny’s ghost to terrify Stan and the others into figuring out the conspiracy in the town, Kenny has fully returned to the series and expected to be alive moving forward. But it really threw fans for a loop with how series creators Trey Parker and Matt Stone went about it.

South Park Season 29 Scares With Kenny’s Return From Death

South Park Season 29 Episode 6 brought the season to end by wrapping all of the smaller stories together. While this season was directly tying its episodes together like seen last year, the episodes this time around have had some elements that have been serialized and moving the story forward. This all comes to fruition as a ghostly version of Kenny starts to haunt the boys into figuring out how he was killed in the first place. Naturally, it’s not long before they find out that Randy did it.

But while the premiere episode had Randy ( who remains in his Little Randy form seemingly heading into Season 30 ) and the other cyclists blowing up Kenny to put an end to the E-Bike problem, it turns out to have been a conspiracy from the entire town. The mayor had agreed to build data centers in town, and killing Kenny and stopping the E-Bikes was just a way to help curb all of it. Either way, it’s all resolved by the end of the episode as the town realizes they’ve been acting so strange.

What Does This Mean for South Park Season 30?

South Park Season 29 ends with the town changing its name back to “South Park,” and Kenny has been brought back to life. Naturally there’s no explanation as to how he’s just come back to life after being killed off once more, but it likely falls further into his curse that had been detailed during Kenny’s Mysterion days. As for the rest of the series, it seems to have also been returned to its pre-Trump status quo with a few key changes heading into Season 30.

One is the fact that Randy seems to be stuck as Little Randy as of the last time we see him, but that can easily be thrown out with the next season premiere. Another is that Tuong Lu Kim has been sent into space with no signs of returning. With South Park returning for Season 30 next year, it could end up being a big milestone for the animated series. How did you like South Park Season 29 overall? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: Transformers: Peter Cullen’s Final Optimus Prime Performance Is Free Online for Very Limited Time – Watch Now
content:
You can now check out Peter Cullen’s final performance as Optimus Prime thanks to a new Transformers short that’s streaming online for free for a very, very limited time. Cullen tragically passed away earlier this year at the age of 85 , but thankfully he was able to record one final performance as Optimus Prime. To help celebrate the 40th anniversary of Transformers: The Movie , it was re-released with a special new short featuring one final look at Optimus Prime after the events of the classic.

Transformers: The Movie had screened in theaters earlier this year with the new “Optimus Prime: Awakening” short attached , and it will be coming to Blu-ray later this December. But through the weekend, fans can now stream Transformers: The Movie complete with the new Optimus short for free on YouTube so even more fans can see Cullen’s final performance. You can check it out below before it’s gone.

Transformers – Optimus Prime Awakening Releases on YouTube for Limited Time

Optimus Prime: Awakening is a special short included in the limited edition 40th anniversary release of Transformers: The Movie ‘s 4K + Blu-ray steelbook. It’s a stamp on Cullen’s legacy in the role of Optimus Prime that began in the original TV animated series, and has gone on to being the de-facto incarnation of the character in future franchise releases live the live-action Transformers films. And this short is a look back at Optimus as the entire scope of the character’s legac y comes into focus in a rather cool way.

Those who had seen Optimus Prime: Awakening when it originally ran in theaters had noted how it was a suitable way to send off Cullen and honor his time with the franchise, and now it’s even more clear as to why with it being available to watch online in this way. It’s Optimus seeing the long road ahead while he sits at a crossroads following his initial fate in Transformers: The Movie . And that’s the kind of legacy that Cullen leaves behind as well as fans will always think of him when bringing up Optimus Prime.

What’s Next for Transformers ?

The Transformers franchise remains in flux, and that’s even more true following the Skydance merger. Rumors for the potential eighth film in the live-action franchise are teasing that Michael Bay might be returning, and casting details seem to tease an effort to return to the initial dynamics seen in the first film with a kid getting caught up in the middle of a space war. Nothing has been officially confirmed or way or the other, but that’s kind of been the case for the franchise for the last few years.

Transformers has had a lot of starts and stops over the years with new attempts to move the franchise forward not meeting expectations at the box office for one reason or another. It’s left the former Paramount to retool and attempt in some other way, but we’ll have to see how it works out. At least the classics hold up. How do you like Peter Cullen’s last outing at Optimus Prime? Let us know your thoughts in the comments.

title: Sty's The Sorcery Emperor's Aide Breaks the Second Catastrophe Novels Get Manga Adaptation
content:
The December issue of Kadokawa 's Comp Ace magazine announced on October 26 that Sty 's Majutsutei no Sanbō wa Nidome no Hametsu wo Uchikudaku ( The Sorcery Emperor's Aide Breaks the Second Catastrophe ) light novel will get a manga adaptation by artist Raku Okuda . The manga launched in the magazine's January 2027 issue that shipped on Thursday.

The story centers on magician Balam, who also serves as the strategist for his childhood friend Anim, the Magic Emperor. With the threat of the "Seraph" destroying the world, Balam uses the magic gem handed to him by his late girlfriend to unleash the full potential of his skill "Transformation Magic," which can transform his own death and life. To save his childhood friend, Balam restarts his life from his childhood before Anim became the Magic Emperor.

Sty launched the story on the Kakuyomu website in January 2024. Kadokawa published the novels' first volume (image right) with illustration by Shikiso on July 17, and the second volume on November 17.

Sty launched the Return of the Corpse King: Reining in My Cringe Secret Society ( Shiō no Kikan: Motoyūsha no Ore, Jibun ga Soshiki Shita Chūni Himitsu Kessha wo Tomeru Tame ni Futatabi Isekai ni Shōkan Sareteshimau ) story on Kakuyomu in 2023. Kadokawa started publishing the novels with illustration by Tsumeki in 2024. The novels' fourth volume shipped on November 25. J-Novel Club publishes the novels in English. The novels also have a manga adaptation by Sotoba Adashino , which launched on the KadoComi website in 2025.

title: Pokemon Anime Confirms 2027 Return After Longest Hiatus in 30 Years
content:
With Pokémon kicking off the 30th anniversary of the TV anime series next year, it has unfortunately confirmed that fans will have to wait through a very long hiatus before it returns with new episodes in 2027. Pokémon’ s TV anime has undergone quite a bit of change over the last few years as not only did it say goodbye to Ash Ketchum , but the latest arcs of the series has put its new protagonists through some very tough challenges. And their adventure is set to continue with more.

Pokémon Horizons: The Series has revealed that it will be wrapping up the final episodes of the Wonder Voyage arc in Japan later this year , and that will cap off the first major season of Liko and Roy’s anime adventures. Now the series has confirmed that it will be returning for a new season next October, following a nine month hiatus for the Pokémon TV anime series. Which is the longest single break in the franchise’s nearly 30 year history of being on the air.

Pokémon Confirms Anime Hiatus Until October 2027 Return

The Pokémon anime franchise has announced that Pokémon Horizons: The Series ‘ final episodes will be airing on December 4th, December 11th, and December 18th in Japan. The series will then be going on a break for several months after with a special 30th anniversary program airing in its time slot in Japan where the franchise will help to celebrate the 30th anniversary milestone of the Pokémon anime series . But as for new episodes, they won’t begin in Japan until sometime next October.

No concrete release date has been set for the Pokémon anime’s return as of this initial announcement, but it will be another season following Liko and Roy’s adventures. Potential titles and more have yet to be revealed for the new season, but this is further confirmation that Ash’s time with the franchise really has come to an end. If he misses out on the 30th anniversary of the series , then it’s likely that the franchise really doesn’t have any intention of bringing Ash back anytime soon. It’s time to move forward with future generations.

What Does This Mean for Pokémon’ s Anime Future?

This does raise some questions over what this means for Pokémon ‘s future. This lengthy hiatus will fall in line with the upcoming release of the next generation of the original Pokémon games with Pokémon Winds and Waves . This new region will likely get some focus in the coming season of the anime, so that’s probably why this is going to be the first real hiatus for the weekly anime series. It might not release internationally at the same pace , but the anime really continues to be a staple in Japan.

Next year might be the 30th anniversary of the Pokémon TV anime series, but fans already got their big anniversary celebration through Ash’s final two seasons that saw him becoming a world champion before retiring. That’s as big as that kind of commemoration could get, so likely don’t expect that moving into this next season. For now, make sure to catch up with Pokémon’s latest episodes now streaming with Netflix.

Potential titles and more have yet to be revealed for the new season, but this is further confirmation that Ash’s time with the franchise really has come to an end. If he misses out on the 30th anniversary of the series , then it’s likely that the franchise really doesn’t have any intention of bringing Ash back anytime soon. It’s time to move forward with future generations.
What Does This Mean for Pokémon’ s Anime Future?

contentBlocks.text: This does raise some questions over what this means for Pokémon ‘s future. This lengthy hiatus will fall in line with the upcoming release of the next generation of the original Pokémon games with Pokémon Winds and Waves . This new region will likely get some focus in the coming season of the anime, so that’s probably why this is going to be the first real hiatus for the weekly anime series. It might not release internationally at the same pace , but the anime really continues to be a staple in Japan.

Next year might be the 30th anniversary of the Pokémon TV anime series, but fans already got their big anniversary celebration through Ash’s final two seasons that saw him becoming a world champion before retiring. That’s as big as that kind of commemoration could get, so likely don’t expect that moving into this next season. For now, make sure to catch up with Pokémon’s latest episodes now streaming with Netflix.

title: Overgeared Reveals First Look at Final Episodes With New Climax Trailer – Watch
content:
Overgeared has been taking over the Fall 2026 anime season with its episodes thus far, and it’s getting ready for its climax with a special teaser trailer revealing the first look at the anime’s final episodes. The anime adaptation for Saenal’s Korean web novel series has really made waves this Fall with not only its fun take on video game anime settings, but also offering a hilarious main character who only wants to cheese the system and make money as fast as he possibly can.

Overgeared previously revealed that it would only be running for a single cour of 12 episodes for the anime’s debut season , and now the finale is even closer than ever with Episode 10 coming this weekend. With so few episodes left, Overgeared is teasing fans with an action packed final wave of episodes with a special teaser trailer revealing the first footage from these future episodes. You can check it out in action below.

When Does Overgeared Season One’s Finale Come Out?

There’s only three episodes of Overgeared left, which means that the first season will likely be coming to an end on December 13th barring any unforeseen schedule shake ups behind the scenes. These final episodes have seen Grid getting into what seems like his biggest string of quests to date as he’s now in the middle of a major war. Now that he’s joined up with a guild and seemingly locked into saving a kingdom, we’ll have to see what that means for his future going forward.

It’s the perfect time to catch up with everything that’s happened so far as well as Overgeared is now streaming exclusively with Crunchyroll. The series offers both a Japenese and English dubbed audio release, but fans should definitely try out the English dub. You might have seen a few of its clips going viral with fans online with the freedom the English localization is given to amp up some of Grid’s quirks, and that’s made for a very unique experience thus far. It’s also just been a fun series to see unfold this far.

What Makes Overgeared So Interesting?

Overgeared might have initially seemed to be following in the same tracks as previous Korean webcomic turned anime hits like Solo Leveling , but it immediately stood out as something unique when it premiered. Rather than put Grid through any real danger, it’s all set within a fun video game world where he can earn some real money if he’s successful. And given that he’s such a goblin of a player, it makes it all the more fun seeing him approach everything around him like a game that he can exploit.

It’s also helped by the fact that Overgeared really has been impressing fans with how much it invests into its big fights and moments , and one of the recent episodes was the best example of this yet. Showcasing a full guild’s fight against a boss, it probably was one of the better showcases of a video game translated to anime action in a while. But how are you liking Overgeared heading into the finale? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: HIDIVE Confirms 2027 Release for Major Isekai Movie Return After 4 Years – Watch New Trailer
content:
There’s a major Isekai anime franchise coming back with a new movie next year after four years of waiting, and HIDIVE has now confirmed it will be overseeing its release outside of Japan with a new trailer and poster to help show it off. The anime adaptation for Daisuke Aizawa and Tozai’s The Eminence in Shadow light novel has become one of the quickest Isekai successes of the last few years , but it’s finally coming back for more with a new feature film picking up from where the TV series left off.

The Eminence in Shadow: Lost Echoes is a brand new feature film picking up from the events of the anime’s second season , and HIDIVE has now confirmed that they will be overseeing the release of the new movie for fans in North America and other territories. To help celebrate the new release, HIDIVE has dropped the first full trailer and poster for the upcoming movie to give fans the best look at what to expect yet. You can check it out in action below.

The Eminence in Shadow: Lost Echoes Confirms 2027 HIDIVE Release

The Eminence in Shadow: Lost Echoes will be making its debut sometime next year with HIDIVE overseeing its launch , but a concrete release window or date has yet to be confirmed as of this time. The film currently has a release slated for sometime in May 2027 in Japan, but hopefully the international release won’t be too much further out from that. You’re going to want to catch up with everything seen in the TV anime’s first two seasons with HIDIVE in the meantime as it’s throwing fans right back into the thick of the action with Shadow.

The Eminence in Shadow: Lost Echoes f eatures a returning production staff from the TV series with Kazuya Nakaishi directing the film for studio Nexus. Makoto Iino will be prodicing the character designs, Kanichi Katou will be providing the screenplay, and Kenichiro Suehiro composes the music. It’s set to feature some returning members to the voice cast such as Seiichiro Yamashita as Cid Kagenou, Yui Horie as Akane Nishino, Inori Minase as Beta, and Takehito Koyasu as Mordred. But there’s some new additions too.

What to Know for New Eminence in Shadow Movie

The Eminence in Shadow: Lost Echoes picks right up after the end of the second season from 2023 as Shadow found himself suddenly sucked into a portal to another world. It’s revealed to be a version of Japan that’s fell to ruin in unexpected ways, and the movie will see him reuniting with a familiar (but different) face for the experience. It seems like it’s a story that’s going to fit perfectly within all of the other events that The Eminence in Shadow is building to with the TV series, so fans will need to check it out to get the next step of the journey.

New additions to the voice cast for this new movie are Yukari Tamura as Yuka Asakura and Rie Kugimiya as Minoru, both characters who have yet to reveal their parts in what’s next. But it’s something to keep an eye on as Shadow’s story develops further. How are you liking the look of The Eminence in Shadow ‘s new movie return so far? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: 'Free Fire Daybreak' Unveils Main Cast, Fourth Promo
content:
The Free Fire World Series Global Finals 2026 event revealed the main cast and a fourth promotional video for the television anime Free Fire Daybreak on Saturday. The anime series will premiere in April 2027.

Voice actors Kana Ichinose ( Sousou no Frieren ) and Seiichirou Yamashita ( Kage no Jitsuryokusha ni Naritakute! ) are starring as Kelly and Hayato, respectively.

Ken Takahashi is directing the anime at Studio CANDY BOX , with Hotaru Asafuji ( Azur Lane: Bisoku Zenshin! Ni!! ) handling the series composition and script. Kouji Fujimoto (Sus4 Inc.) ( Yozakura-san Chi no Daisakusen ) is composing the music.

Garena Free Fire is an immersive battle royale game developed by 111dots Studio and published by Garena in 2017, created for mobile devices. It was the most downloaded mobile game in the world in 2019, 2021, 2023, and 2024. The game has over 1 billion cumulative downloads on the Google Play Store, with over 100 million daily active users in February 2024. In September 2021, Garena released an enhanced version of the game titled Free Fire Max .
